_about: Source for the LTDA collection records (RWA: real-world archive). Each entry becomes one canonical record file; the record file's SHA-256 is a Merkle leaf. Photo hashes are of the files exactly as Kevan sent them (data/intake/2026-10-26-onedrive-batch/hashes.tsv). Stories are Kevan's own words from chat 2026-10-26. Fields marked 'to confirm' or 'to record' are his to fill before the version that gets anchored.
